author: polikinha2021

title: Terrible app - Waste of money
body:
Save your money. This app is bad and doesn’t really do any of the things they sell.

First, all this app has is a poorly executed collection of content made by other similar (and more well known) apps.

Second, their trial doesn’t include the Premium section, which is the norm in this sort of business model.

Third, they rope you in with features that don’t really exist. Or if they do they’re very well hidden…
